title: Securities Trading Policy

tiers.name: Directors
tiers.description: All executive and non-executive directors of Cleanaway Waste Management Limited and its subsidiaries (the Group). Subject to the Trading Windows, the derivatives and short-term dealing bans, and the additional prior written approval regime in section 3.3.

tiers.name: Executives
tiers.description: The Chief Executive Officer, persons with direct reporting responsibilities to the CEO, and persons with direct reporting responsibilities to one of those persons. Subject to the same additional prior written approval regime as Directors under section 3.3.

tiers.name: Employees
tiers.description: All employees of the Group. Bound by the Trading Windows, the derivatives and hedging prohibition and the three-month short-term dealing ban, but need no prior approval to deal inside a Trading Window; margin loan restrictions apply only to the extent their margin loans are considered material.

tiers.name: Related Parties
tiers.description: Immediate family members (partner, spouse, children or parents) who may be expected to influence or be influenced by the Director or Executive; a company, trust or other entity controlled by them; and the trustee of a trust or fiduciary arrangement of which they are a beneficiary. The policy also extends generally to dealings through entities or trusts controlled by Directors and Employees or in which they have an interest.

definitions.hedging_definition: you cannot enter into any hedging arrangements or acquire financial products (such as equity swaps, caps and collars or other hedging products) over unvested performance rights which have the effect of reducing or limiting exposure to risks associated with the market value of CWY securities

windows.start_anchor: the trading day after the release of CWY's half-year and full-year results to the ASX
windows.end_anchor: up to 6 weeks after the trading day following the results release

windows.start_anchor: the trading day after the Annual General Meeting has been held
windows.end_anchor: up to 6 weeks after the trading day following the AGM

windows.start_anchor: any time CWY has a prospectus open
any other time the Board declares trading permissible in a written note to all staff and the ASX
windows.end_anchor: as stated in the Board's written note

ad_hoc_blackout_authority: No express power to declare additional blackout periods; the Board's declaration power only opens extra Trading Windows. In substance CWY can block any dealing at any time: any request for approval can be refused by CWY in its absolute discretion, a granted approval may be revoked by the Company at any time at its absolute discretion, and Directors and Executives will not be given approval where price sensitive non-public information exists 'even though they may not be aware of it'. A refusal must be kept confidential.

rules.detail: Flat prohibition on trading in CWY derivatives by Directors and Employees, expressed to apply to all CWY securities and not limited by venue, so an OTC put or call written or bought with a bank over CWY shares is caught. The following sentence explains the ban by reference to hedging products over unvested performance rights, which creates a drafting tension, but the operative sentence is unqualified.
rules.evidence: Directors and Employees must not trade in CWY derivatives.  This applies to all CWY securities including performance rights issued under CWYs incentive schemes.

rules.detail: Collars are named in terms: equity swaps, caps and collars or other hedging products over unvested performance rights that reduce or limit exposure to the market value of CWY securities are prohibited outright, with no approval route.
rules.evidence: It means that you cannot enter into any hedging arrangements or acquire financial products (such as equity swaps, caps and collars or other hedging products) over unvested performance rights which have the effect of reducing or limiting exposure to risks associated with the market value of CWY securities.

rules.detail: Hedging vested shares is not separately addressed, but a hedge is executed through derivatives and the derivatives ban is expressed to apply to 'all CWY securities', so a collar over vested unrestricted shares is prohibited. The only textual argument the other way is that the explanatory sentence limits itself to unvested performance rights; the policy has no clearance route that could cure the point.
rules.evidence: Directors and Employees must not trade in CWY derivatives.  This applies to all CWY securities including performance rights issued under CWYs incentive schemes.

rules.detail: Monetisation, prepaid forwards and zero-cost collars are not named as such. Any structure that monetises CWY securities through a derivative is caught by the ban on trading in CWY derivatives and, where it reduces or limits market-value exposure, by the hedging prohibition. Monetisation by outright sale remains possible inside a Trading Window with approval.
rules.evidence: Directors and Employees must not trade in CWY derivatives.  This applies to all CWY securities including performance rights issued under CWYs incentive schemes.

rules.detail: Short selling is nowhere named. In practice a short position in CWY would be taken through a derivative (prohibited under 3.4) and a physical short sale would breach the three-month same-securities rule, but the policy contains no short selling clause.
Securities lending is not mentioned and there is no definition of dealing that would sweep it in.
CFDs are not named, but a CFD over CWY shares is a CWY derivative and so falls within the flat prohibition in 3.4; it would also breach the ban on short-term or speculative trading.
rules.evidence: Directors and Employees must not engage in short-term or speculative trading in CWY securities.

rules.detail: Directors are prohibited directly or indirectly from entering into any margin loan facility against CWY securities unless the prior written consent of the Chairman of the CWY Board has been obtained. No criteria are given for consent, no validity period, no disclosure obligation and no rules on margin calls or forced sales.
rules.evidence: Unless the prior written consent of the Chairman of the CWY Board has been obtained, all: Directors of CWY; ... are prohibited directly or indirectly from entering into any margin loan facility against CWY securities.

rules.detail: Executives are subject to the same gateway as Directors: no margin loan facility against CWY securities, directly or indirectly, without the Chairman's prior written consent. The prohibition also reaches their related parties.
rules.evidence: Unless the prior written consent of the Chairman of the CWY Board has been obtained, all: ... Executives of CWY; ... and Related parties of the above persons, are prohibited directly or indirectly from entering into any margin loan facility against CWY securities.

rules.detail: Employees are caught only to the extent their margin loans are considered material; materiality is undefined and the policy does not say who assesses it. Where material, the Chairman's prior written consent is required.
rules.evidence: Employees of CWY (to the extent that their margin loans are considered material); and Related parties of the above persons, are prohibited directly or indirectly from entering into any margin loan facility against CWY securities.

rules.detail: Granting security, a charge, lien, pledge or mortgage over CWY securities is not itself treated as a dealing or otherwise regulated; there is no dealing definition at all. The only encumbrance-adjacent provision is the margin loan clause in 3.5.

There is no general ban on secured financing; the only regulated form is a 'margin loan facility against CWY securities', which needs the Chairman's prior written consent. A limited-recourse or collar loan secured on CWY shares with loan-to-value top-up or margin features would in substance be treated as a margin loan facility 'directly or indirectly' against CWY securities and so require that consent; a plain secured loan with no margin mechanics is not expressly addressed.
rules.evidence: are prohibited directly or indirectly from entering into any margin loan facility against CWY securities.

rules.detail: Bright-line ban: no dealing in the same CWY securities within any three month period, in addition to a general ban on short-term or speculative trading. No carve-out is given for plan securities or for the exempt dealings in 3.6.
rules.evidence: Directors and Employees must not engage in short-term or speculative trading in CWY securities. Specifically, for the purposes of this policy, this means that Directors and Employees must not deal in the same CWY securities within any three month period.

clearance.approver: The Chairman and the Chair of the Audit and Risk Committee; for the Chairman, the Chair of the Audit and Risk Committee and the Chair of the Human Resources Committee; for the Chair of the Audit and Risk Committee, the Chairman and the Chair of the Human Resources Committee
clearance.post_trade_to: Company Secretary (written details of the trade, referring to the prior approval); Directors' trades notified to the ASX as required by law
clearance.post_trade_deadline: within two business days of the trade
clearance.evidence: Before any Director or Executive deals in any CWY securities at any time, including during Trading Windows, he or she must obtain written approval to the proposed dealing ... If an approved share trade is conducted, it must occur within 3 business days from the date that the approval is provided and must not exceed the number of shares that were the subject of the request.

clearance.approver: The Chairman and the Chair of the Audit and Risk Committee for Executive Team members; the Company Secretary for persons with direct reporting responsibilities to the Executive Team
clearance.post_trade_to: Company Secretary (written details of the trade, referring to the prior approval)
clearance.post_trade_deadline: within two business days of the trade
clearance.evidence: Any request for approval can be refused by CWY in its absolute discretion and is unlikely to be granted outside of Trading Windows (except in exceptional circumstances, eg: severe financial hardship).  If an approval to trade is granted, it may be revoked by the Company at any time at its absolute discretion.

clearance.approver: Company Secretary (required only to dispose of securities outside a Trading Window; no approval needed to deal inside a Trading Window)
clearance.post_trade_to: Company Secretary (all details of such trades, referring to the prior approval)
clearance.post_trade_deadline: within two business days of the trade
clearance.evidence: If Employees, Directors or Executives wish to dispose of securities outside these Trading Windows they must obtain prior written approval from the Company Secretary.  Approval will only be granted in exceptional circumstances (eg: cases of financial hardship) and where the Employee is not in possession of inside information.

short_term.basis: no dealing in the same CWY securities within any three month period
short_term.evidence: Specifically, for the purposes of this policy, this means that Directors and Employees must not deal in the same CWY securities within any three month period.

exceptions.evidence: where the trade would result in no change in beneficial interest in the Company’s securities (i.e. Company securities already held in a company or trust controlled by the employee or an employee’s superannuation fund in which the person is a beneficiary are transferred to that person or vice versa);

acceptance of an offer or invitation made to all or most of the Company’s Security holders, such as a rights issue, share buy-back or dividend reinvestment plan, where the plan that determines the timing and structure of the offer has been approved by the Board;
the exercise (but not the sale of securities following exercise) of an option or right under an employee incentive scheme of the Group;
subscription and/or acquisition of CWY securities by the Company’s Executive Share Trustee for the purpose of fulfilling the Company’s obligations under any employee incentive scheme of the Group.

exceptions.approver: Company Secretary (Chairman and committee chairs for Directors and Executives under 3.3)
exceptions.evidence: Approval will only be granted in exceptional circumstances (eg: cases of financial hardship) and where the Employee is not in possession of inside information.

However, exceptional circumstances justifying consent being given may exist if the person is required by a court order, or there are court enforceable undertakings in a bona fide family settlement (for example), to transfer or sell the securities or there is some other overriding legal or regulatory requirement to do so.

exemption_authority: Company Secretary may approve a disposal outside a Trading Window, and the Chairman and relevant committee chairs may approve a Director's or Executive's dealing, but only in exceptional circumstances such as severe financial hardship or a court order, and any request may be refused in CWY's absolute discretion. The Chairman of the Board may consent to a margin loan facility against CWY securities. There is no authority to exempt anyone from the derivatives and hedging prohibition or the three-month short-term dealing ban. The Board may amend the Policy.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Directors and Employees must not trade in CWY derivatives. This applies to all CWY securities including performance rights issued under CWYs incentive schemes.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Both legs of a collar are CWY derivatives, so the structure is prohibited outright for every Director and Employee with no clearance or hardship route available.

bespoke_clauses.clause: you cannot enter into any hedging arrangements or acquire financial products (such as equity swaps, caps and collars or other hedging products) over unvested performance rights which have the effect of reducing or limiting exposure to risks associated with the market value of CWY securities
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Collars are named in terms, removing any argument that the ban was not intended to reach this product, although the explanatory sentence is drafted by reference to unvested performance rights only.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Section 3.4 first bans trading in CWY derivatives over 'all CWY securities', then explains the ban only by reference to hedging 'over unvested performance rights'.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The only conceivable opening for a collar over vested shares is to read the operative ban down to the explanatory sentence, which would require the Board to confirm the narrow reading in writing before a bank could rely on it.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Unless the prior written consent of the Chairman of the CWY Board has been obtained, all Directors, Executives, Employees (to the extent that their margin loans are considered material) and Related parties of the above persons are prohibited directly or indirectly from entering into any margin loan facility against CWY securities.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The loan leg is not banned outright, unlike the derivative legs, but a facility secured on CWY shares would need the Chairman's prior written consent, and 'directly or indirectly' catches structures routed through related entities.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Each Director and Executive must also take all reasonable steps to ensure that their Related Parties do not deal in CWY securities without the Director or Executive obtaining approval ... Related party ... An immediate family member ... A company, trust or other entity that is controlled by the relevant Director or Executive; or The trustee of a trust or fiduciary arrangement of which the relevant Director or Executive is a beneficiary.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Placing the collar or the borrowing in a family trust or controlled company does not escape the derivatives ban, the approval requirement or the margin loan consent gateway.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Directors and Employees must not deal in the same CWY securities within any three month period.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Even if a hedge were permitted, entry, roll, partial unwind and physical settlement over the same parcel inside three months would breach the policy, so any structure must be long dated with settlement outside the window.

bespoke_clauses.clause: If an approval to trade is granted, it may be revoked by the Company at any time at its absolute discretion. If an approved share trade is conducted, it must occur within 3 business days from the date that the approval is provided and must not exceed the number of shares that were the subject of the request.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Pricing, documentation and execution of any approved transaction must complete within three business days and remain revocable until done, which is difficult for a negotiated OTC structure.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Directors and Executives will not be given approval to deal in CWY securities under sections 3.2 or 3.3 of this policy where price sensitive, non-public information exists in relation to a matter, even though they may not be aware of it.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Approval can be withheld for information the executive does not hold, so a bank cannot treat a clean insider-trading representation as sufficient for the transaction to proceed.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Where a request for approval is refused, that refusal must be kept confidential.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The executive may be unable to tell the bank why an agreed collar or unwind cannot proceed, so documentation needs a no-reasons termination right.

bespoke_clauses.clause: For the purpose of this policy, securities can be more than just shares. They also include options, rights and warrants or any instrument which has the feature of converting into an equity interest in the Company. They can include bonds and other financial products.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: OTC options over CWY shares are securities under the policy, with no venue limitation, so an off-market bank trade is treated the same as an on-market one.

bespoke_clauses.clause: The exceptional circumstances relief in section 3.2 is expressed only as approval to 'dispose of securities outside these Trading Windows'.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The hardship route can unlock a sale but cannot authorise a derivative or hedging transaction, so it offers no path to a collar.

summary: A funded collar is not possible under this policy as drafted. Section 3.4 bans Directors and Employees from trading in CWY derivatives, expressly extends that ban to all CWY securities, and names 'caps and collars' among the prohibited hedging products, so both the purchased put and the written call are prohibited outright, with no clearance, hardship or exemption route; the only textual counter-argument is that the explanatory sentence is framed around unvested performance rights, which would need express Board confirmation before a bank could rely on it. The loan leg is treated more leniently: a margin loan facility against CWY securities, directly or indirectly, is permitted with the prior written consent of the Chairman of the CWY Board, and no disclosure, price trigger or forced sale rules are imposed. Even if the derivative legs were permitted, execution would have to occur inside a Trading Window (six weeks after each results release and after the AGM), with prior written approval from the Chairman and Chair of the Audit and Risk Committee that lasts only three business days, is revocable at absolute discretion, and can be refused because of price sensitive information the executive does not know about. The three-month same-securities rule would also require a long-dated structure with no early unwind, and the whole regime extends to related parties, so routing the trade through a family trust or controlled company changes nothing.
